scientific_question: Explore coherent constant-density structure in the annular-combustor flow by extracting the Density isosurface at the 90th percentile of finite stored values. Consider every connected isosurface component as a candidate, select the one with the largest surface area, and describe it using its area-weighted centroid and surface area. Report the principal findings that the data support, including the structure’s identity and defining density level, along with a scientifically relevant characterization of your choice concerning its extent, location, or shape.
